prompt_edits: Add a mandatory canonical-value ledger pass before adjudication: every reused value must be traced to its operating point and denominator (initial vs whole-context KV, 10 rps vs 40 rps, per-token vs per-request, theoretical vs sustained). This would have caught the CH11-02 and CH25-01 false positives and the CH4-03/CH25-01 volume-basis issues.

Require figure findings to include a rendered crop or exact coordinates plus the exact caption span and the arithmetic chain from the figure's own labels. Without that, visual findings should default to NEEDS-VERIFICATION rather than P0/P1. This round contains many figure-only claims that cannot be adjudicated from text.

Add a unit/request-basis check to every numeric finding: write the dimensional chain (tokens, requests, per-1K-token, per-month, per-host, per-GPU) and test the benign reading before filing. This would have prevented the DeepSeek:CH16-01 unit-conversion false positive and forced clearer separation of per-request versus per-token costs.
